bonk.fighter: Sir Bonk, a stocky knight with a bucket helmet topped by a brush plume, a cape and a long wooden plank sword

1.subject: Squire's Cut: a quick forward cut, the plank sweeping out in front of him at waist height

3.subject: Sunrise: a rising swing, the plank sweeping from low in front of him up to straight overhead

4.subject: The BONK: a huge overhead slam, the plank smashing down onto the ground in front of him with an impact burst

A.subject: Pot-Lid Throw: he flings his round metal pot lid like a frisbee straight ahead, the spinning lid trailing a curved spin swoosh; show the lid in flight and his open throwing hand and forearm behind it

E.subject: Targeted Jump Slam: he leaps high with the plank raised overhead, about to slam down onto a target spot below
E.direction: up and then down in an arc

R.subject: The Joust: he charges on a toy hobby horse (a stuffed horse head on a stick, red yarn mane, big button eyes) with his long wooden plank couched under his arm as a lance

F.subject: Windmill: he spins his long wooden plank sword in a flat full circle around himself at hip height

fightguy.fighter: FightGuy, a martial artist with a headband, sleeveless gi top and fingerless gloves

1.subject: Straight Punch: a lunging straight punch, fist driving forward

3.subject: High Kick: a high side kick, the foot striking forward and up at head height

4.subject: Double Kick: an upside-down flip, hands near the ground, both feet kicking straight up

A.subject: Ki Shot: both palms thrust forward, firing a dense round ki ball with a short swept-back tail

E.subject: Rising Dragon: a jumping rising uppercut, fist leading straight up

R.subject: Cyclone Kick: a spinning kick, leg extended, his body rotating

F.subject: Fist of Fury: a rapid flurry of many punches, several fists blurring forward

manki.fighter: Manki, a wiry cartoon monkey with goggles, a long tail and a small jetpack

1.subject: Monkey Punch: a lunging right punch

3.subject: Sweeping Kick: a low kick sweeping along the ground

4.subject: Head Slam: he dives head-first forward and down like a battering ram, skull leading, body stretched in one diagonal line behind it, tail trailing, an orange impact burst where his head hits

A.subject: Round Bomb: he lobs a round black bomb with a lit fuse in a high arc
A.direction: up and forward in an arc

E.subject: Jetpack Boost: he blasts straight up on his jetpack, a burst of exhaust flame below

R.subject: Bazooka: he fires a bazooka from his shoulder, the rocket flying forward with a smoke trail

F.subject: Aerosol Inferno: he sprays an aerosol can through a lighter flame, projecting a forward column of fire

wibou.fighter: Wibou, a lanky ninja in a long coat and cap with a katana

1.subject: Quick Slash: a fast forward-down katana slash

3.subject: Up Slash: a leaping upward katana slash

4.subject: Heavy Down Slash: a heavy two-handed slash driven down into the ground

A.subject: Shuriken Toss: he throws three shuriken forward in a fan

E.subject: Rising Slash: he rises up into the air on an upward katana slash

R.subject: Dash Slash: he dashes forward low with the blade trailing, leaving a long dash streak

F.subject: Skyfall: he plunges straight down from the sky, body vertical, both hands driving the katana point-first straight down below him; long vertical speed lines above him and an impact burst on the ground under the blade tip

bashie.fighter: Bashie, a cartoon lifeguard turtle with a big floppy sun hat, a one-piece swimsuit, a round shell and water wings

1.subject: Whirlpool Spin: she is tucked into her round shell (hat on top), seen slightly from above, spinning in place; one big closed whirlpool ring circles the shell and splash droplets fly outward. The circular ring is the main read.

3.subject: Shell Flip: her tucked shell is upside down mid-backflip; one big curved arrow loops up and backward over it from a small splash on the ground. The looping backward arrow is the main read.
3.direction: up and back in a flip

4.subject: Rising Shell: her tucked shell rockets diagonally forward and up like a cannonball, long straight speed lines trailing down and back, a small impact burst ahead of it. The diagonal launch is the main read.

A.subject: Hose Down: she sprays a strong water stream forward from a toy water blaster

E.subject: Hydro Jet: tucked into her shell, she shoots off with a water jet blasting behind her

R.subject: Shell Shift: she drops into her shell and skates forward along the ground
R.direction: forward to the right, along the ground

F.subject: NO RUNNING!: she puffs up and blows a lifeguard whistle, sound waves ringing out around her (draw the waves, never any words)

salamander.fighter: the Salamander, a lanky salamander gunslinger with a wide sombrero, a poncho and a long tail

1.subject: Backhand Slap: an open-hand backhand slap swept out to his side

3.subject: Uppercut: he dips, then drives his fist straight up over the sombrero

4.subject: Tail Spin: he spins one full turn with his tail stretched out, sweeping all round him

A.subject: Finger Guns: he fires a finger gun made of index and middle fingers, one bullet flying forward with a small muzzle flash

E.subject: Sombrero Copter: holding the brim, he spins his sombrero overhead like a helicopter rotor and lifts off

R.subject: Tumbleweed: tucked into a ball, he rolls forward like a tumbleweed

F.subject: Big Iron: he fires a big slow shot from a two-handed finger gun, the recoil throwing his arms up
